title: Shyam Sunder Luthara v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Dilip B. Bhosale, C.J. and Yashwant Varma, J.
disposition: Writ not pressed; liberty to CGRF/Ombudsman under clause 7.10
headnote: Writ-C by a consumer against the State of U.P. and others was not pressed. The High Court disposed of the petition as not pressed and granted the liberty sought, namely to approach the Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum and the Ombudsman under clause 7.10 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005. Merits of the supply dispute were not examined.
facts: Shyam Sunder Luthara filed Writ-C No. 12664 of 2017 in the Allahabad High Court against the State of Uttar Pradesh and three others. The petition was listed before a Division Bench in the Chief Justice's Court. Counsel did not press the writ on the merits of the underlying electricity dispute, which the order does not narrate, and instead asked that the petitioner be left free to take the grievance to the Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum and the Ombudsman under clause 7.10 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005.

holding_units.topic: liberty to CGRF and Ombudsman on not-pressed writ
holding_units.holding: Where the petitioner does not press a writ and seeks liberty to approach the Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum and the Ombudsman under clause 7.10 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005, the High Court may dispose of the petition as not pressed and grant that liberty without deciding the merits of the supply dispute.

not_decided.point: Merits of the underlying electricity/supply grievance
not_decided.note: Petition not pressed; no facts of the dispute recorded.
